title: Metaorder modelling and identification from public data
abstract: arXiv:2602.19590v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Market-order flow in financial markets exhibits long-range correlations. This is a widely known stylised fact of financial markets. A popular hypothesis for this stylised fact comes from the Lillo-Mike-Farmer (LMF) order-splitting theory. However, quantitative tests of this theory have historically relied on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers, limiting reproducibility and cross-market validation. We investigate whether it can be recovered from anonymous public data using synthetic metaorder reconstruction. Using transaction and quote data for the largest 239 stocks by market capitalisation on the JSE as of 13 March 2026 with the data range being 1 January 2023 until 31 December 2025, we conduct a grid search over reconstruction parameters and evaluate each configuration against established metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation. translated_title: 从公开数据进行元订单建模与识别
translated_abstract: 金融市场中的市价订单流呈现出长程相关性，这是金融市场一个广为人知的典型化事实。关于这一事实的一个流行假说来自Lillo-Mike-Farmer（LMF）订单拆分理论。然而，对该理论的定量检验历来依赖于包含交易者标识符的专有数据集，这限制了研究的可重复性和跨市场验证。我们研究能否利用合成元订单重构方法，从匿名的公开数据中恢复这一理论。我们使用约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）截至2026年3月13日市值最大的239只股票的交易与报价数据（数据范围为2023年1月1日至2025年12月31日），对重构参数进行网格搜索，并根据既定的元订单典型化事实和LMF关系评估每种参数配置。所选配置在元订单冲击的典型化事实方面使误差最小化。
tldr: 该研究提出一种基于合成元订单重构的方法，仅使用匿名公开的行情数据即可识别元订单并验证LMF订单拆分理论，从而摆脱对含交易者标识符的专有数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: This study proposes reconstructing synthetic metaorders from anonymous public market data to identify metaorders and validate the Lillo-Mike-Farmer order-splitting theory, removing the dependence on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers.
